notes.title: Bug fixes and new skills!
notes.notes: I noticed some in game songs weren't looping so I applied a quick fix and made 2 new skills for Harry and Yzzy which makes them harder to kill. Also I have added a new skill for each character once they reach max level as well as smarter AI and players no longer need keys to open chests.

notes.notes: Max stats now set to 66.

notes.notes: Existing player may have to delete save files from local drive to avoid crashing.

notes.title: Promotion bug fix.
notes.notes: I have fixed characters unable to promote.

notes.title: Ver 2.04
notes.notes: Added a few more magic spells in the shops.

notes.title: Ver 2.03
notes.notes: Hard mode revived and I reverted the story back to the original ending, I no longer wish to continue to further this story in this game but I'm prepare to write a new game! Also, with the constant crashing, it's because I update the game too often and can cause the old save file to be incompatible with the game thus causing the crash, if you are crashing simply restart the game from the beginning, it's not a long game anyways.ːsteammockingː

notes.title: Ver 2.02
notes.notes: I decided to continue writing the story, the game now has one more map after the game finishes, I'll try to add more maps and make this game as long as possible. Hard mode has been removed and less EXP during normal gameplay.
